Report of Independent Registered Public Accounting Firm

To the Stockholders and the Board of Directors of Meta Platforms, Inc. Opinion on Internal Control Over Financial Reporting

We have audited Meta Platforms, Inc.'s internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2025, based on criteria established in Internal Control–Integrated Framework issued by the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (2013 framework) (the COSO criteria). In our opinion, Meta Platforms, Inc. (the Company) maintained, in all material respects, effective internal control over financial reporting as of December 31, 2025, based on the COSO criteria. We also have audited, in accordance with the standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (United States) (PCAOB), the consolidated balance sheets of the Company as of December 31, 2025 and 2024, the related consolidated statements of income, comprehensive income, stockholders' equity and cash flows for each of the three years in the period ended December 31, 2025, and the related notes and our report dated January 28, 2026 expressed an unqualified opinion thereon. Basis for Opinion 

The Company's management is responsible for maintaining effective internal control over financial reporting and for its assessment of the effectiveness of internal control over financial reporting included in the accompanying Management's Report on Internal Control over Financial Reporting. Our responsibility is to express an opinion on the Company's internal control over financial reporting based on our audit. We are a public accounting firm registered with the PCAOB and are required to be independent with respect to the Company in accordance with the U.S. federal securities laws and the applicable rules and regulations of the Securities and Exchange Commission and the PCAOB. We conducted our audit in accordance with the standards of the PCAOB. Those standards require that we plan and perform the audit to obtain reasonable assurance about whether effective internal control over financial reporting was maintained in all material respects. Our audit included obtaining an understanding of internal control over financial reporting, assessing the risk that a material weakness exists, testing and evaluating the design and operating effectiveness of internal control based on the assessed risk, and performing such other procedures as we considered necessary in the circumstances. We believe that our audit provides a reasonable basis for our opinion. Definition and Limitations of Internal Control Over Financial Reporting 

A company's internal control over financial reporting is a process designed to provide reasonable assurance regarding the reliability of financial reporting and the preparation of financial statements for external purposes in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles. A company's internal control over financial reporting includes those policies and procedures that (1) pertain to the maintenance of records that, in reasonable detail, accurately and fairly reflect the transactions and dispositions of the assets of the company; (2) provide reasonable assurance that transactions are recorded as necessary to permit preparation of financial statements in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles, and that receipts and expenditures of the company are being made only in accordance with authorizations of management and directors of the company; and (3) provide reasonable assurance regarding prevention or timely detection of unauthorized acquisition, use, or disposition of the company's assets that could have a material effect on the financial statements. Because of its inherent limitations, internal control over financial reporting may not prevent or detect misstatements.

[META 10-K period 2025] We offer competitive compensation and a wide range of benefits, including many learning and development resources. From time to time, we implement organizational changes to pursue greater efficiency and realign our business and strategic priorities. For example, we have previously undertaken cost reduction efforts such as scaling back budgets, reducing company perks, shrinking our real estate footprint, and employee layoffs and restructurings. We make it a priority to treat outgoing employees with respect and provide a generous severance package. For U.S. employees, that includes severance payments, payment for all remaining paid time off, and restricted stock unit vesting through their last day on payroll, as well as certain continuing coverage of the cost of healthcare for employees and their families, career services with an external vendor, and immigration support. We offer similar support for outgoing employees outside of the United States while taking into account local employment laws. 9


Employee Learning and Development

We value our investment in growing and keeping a highly skilled workforce. We aim to make AI utilization core to the way we operate by providing our personnel access to AI tools and training programs. We provide our employees with regular performance reviews twice a year as we believe it is an important part of how we support their growth and career development while also recognizing and rewarding their impact at Meta. We also offer career development opportunities and work experience programs that extend beyond the physical and virtual classroom. To do this, we utilize various learning modalities, such as live virtual and in-person learning experiences, on-demand e-learning, self-service resources, learning communities, and coaching engagements. The Pulse of Our Workforce

We conduct company-wide employee surveys twice a year to help us understand how employees feel about working at Meta and what we can do to improve their experience. Our surveys help us measure company, manager, team, and personal experience over time. Further, our more frequent surveys, such as those that have been administered daily to an ongoing random sample of employees, allow us to measure real-time sentiment around emerging events and company changes. These surveys are designed to invite feedback and actionable suggestions, inform decisions, and drive change across the company. Compensation, Benefits, Health, and Well-being

We offer competitive compensation to attract and retain the best people, and we help care for our people so they can focus on our mission. Our employees' total compensation package includes market-competitive salary, bonuses or sales incentives, and equity. We generally offer full-time employees equity at the time of hire and through annual equity grants because we want them to be owners of the company and committed to our long-term success. Through Life@ Meta, our holistic approach to benefits, we continue to provide our employees and their dependents with resources to help them thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits across areas such as health, family, finance, community, and time away, including family building benefits, family care resources, retirement savings plans, access to legal services, Meta Resource Groups to build community at Meta, and health and well-being benefits. Our health and well-being programs are designed to give employees a choice of flexible benefits to help them reach their personal well-being goals. Our programs are tailored to help boost employee physical and mental health, create financial peace of mind, provide support for families, and help employees build a strong community. The Strength of Our Workforce and People Processes

We work to build an inclusive workplace where we can leverage our collective cognitive diversity to build the best products and make the best decisions for the global community we serve. We want our products to work for people around the world and we need to grow and keep the best talent in order to do that. We remain committed to having an inclusive workplace and people with a broad range of knowledge, skills, political views, backgrounds, and perspectives because we believe cognitive diversity fuels innovation.

records.query: Tesla 最新一季的營收成長與毛利率變化如何？加上新聞中 SpaceX 即將 IPO 讓 Tesla 關注度降溫的報導，這對 Tesla 目前的市場處境有何影響？
records.answer:
Tesla 最新一季（2026 年第二季，三個月截至 6 月 30 日）總營收約 282.4 億美元，年增 26%，但整體毛利率從 17.2% 微降至 16.8%，主要受能源儲存毛利率大幅下滑拖累；同時，新聞報導指出 SpaceX IPO 的熱潮讓 Tesla 的市場關注度降溫，股價近期表現平淡，投資人期待財報能帶來正向驚喜。

**營收成長表現**

Tesla 在 2026 年第二季的總營收為 282.36 億美元，較 2025 年同期的 224.96 億美元增加 57.4 億美元，年增幅約 26% [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #3]。上半年（六個月）總營收為 506.23 億美元，較去年同期 418.31 億美元成長 21% [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #3]。

各業務線的表現如下：
- **汽車銷售**：第二季汽車銷售營收 200.06 億美元，年增 27%，主因現金交付量增加約 25%，以及平均售價因銷售組合改善和美元走弱帶來正面影響，FSD（Supervised）訂閱收入也有所增加 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #75]。
- **汽車監管積分**：營收從 4.39 億美元降至 1.46 億美元，大幅減少 67%，主因近期政府與監管機構行動限制了與 Tesla 產品相關的某些監管積分計畫 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #75]。
- **服務及其他**：第二季營收 45.81 億美元，年增 50%，主要受二手車銷售量與平均售價提升、非保固維修服務、碰撞維修收入及付費超級充電站使用增加帶動 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #76]。
- **能源發電與儲存**：第二季營收 31.39 億美元，年增 13%，主因 Megapack 部署量增加，但被每台 Megapack 平均售價下降及 Powerwall 部署量減少部分抵消 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #76]。

**毛利率變化**

Tesla 的整體毛利率在 2026 年第二季為 16.8%，低於 2025 年同期的 17.2% [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #2]。各分項毛利率變化如下：

- **汽車業務毛利率**：從 17.2% 微降至 16.9%，主因汽車銷售營收與成本結構變化，以及監管積分收入減少 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。
- **汽車及服務與其他分部毛利率**：從 15.4% 提升至 16.4%，受益於服務與其他業務毛利率改善 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。
- **能源發電與儲存分部毛利率**：從 30.3% 大幅下降至 20.4%，主因營收與成本結構變化，包括平均每 MWh 成本上升（受銷售組合與不利保固調整影響）[TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。

**研發與營運支出**

研發費用大幅增加，第二季從 15.89 億美元增至 23.71 億美元，年增 49%，反映 Tesla 在 AI、軟體及車隊利潤方面的大量投資 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。Tesla 明確表示這些投資在現階段將對盈利能力產生負面影響 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #67]。營運支出總計 43.53 億美元，去年同期為 29.55 億美元 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #3]。營業利益從 9.23 億美元降至 3.98 億美元 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #3]。淨利為 11.28 億美元，略低於去年同期的 11.9 億美元 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #3]。

**SpaceX IPO 對 Tesla 市場處境的影響**

根據新聞報導，SpaceX 預計於 2026 年 6 月 12 日以每股 135 美元的價格在 Nasdaq 掛牌上市（股票代號 SPCX）[TSLA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。Yahoo Finance 的報導指出，SpaceX 的 IPO 熱潮使 Tesla 的市場關注度降溫，Tesla 股票「近期沒有太多令人興奮的表現」，被形容為「退居次要位置」[TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。報導中提到，分析師認為在 SpaceX 的光環下，Tesla 不需要太多利多就能帶來「看漲驚喜」，暗示市場對 Tesla 的預期已相對降低 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。此外，報導也提及市場關注 Elon Musk 的下一步可能是「合併」，雖然尚未正式確認，但已被公開討論多年 [TSLA_News_20260721_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**現金流與資本支出**

records.query: Tesla 汽車業務的毛利率近期有什麼變化趨勢？加上新聞中 Magnificent Seven 科技股近期全數下跌的報導，這對 Tesla 的股價表現透露什麼？
records.answer:
Tesla 的汽車業務毛利率在 2026 年上半年呈現波動：Q2 單季毛利率從 17.2% 微降至 16.9%，但 2026 上半年（六個月）累計毛利率則從 16.8% 改善至 18.7% [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #15]。與此同時，新聞報導指出包含 Tesla 在內的「Magnificent Seven」科技股近期全數下跌，Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF 自 6 月 5 日以來跌幅超過 2.4%，分析師認為投資人正在為 SpaceX 上市清理持倉 [NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**汽車業務毛利率變化細節：**

- **Q2 單季（三個月）：** Tesla 總汽車毛利率從 2025 年 Q2 的 17.2% 下降至 2026 年 Q2 的 16.9%，主要原因是汽車銷售收入與成本的變化，以及監管積分收入（regulatory credits revenue）的減少 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。
- **上半年累計（六個月）：** 總汽車毛利率則從 2025 年上半年的 16.8% 提升至 2026 年上半年的 18.7% [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。
- **汽車及服務與其他板塊合計：** Q2 單季毛利率從 15.4% 提升至 16.4%，上半年累計從 14.9% 提升至 17.5%，改善原因包括汽車銷售毛利率變化以及服務與其他業務毛利率的改善 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。
- **成本動因：** 2026 年 Q2 汽車銷售成本增加 33 億美元（增幅 24%），主因是交付量年增；平均每輛車成本相對穩定，因不利的銷售組合與美元走弱被保固調整和關稅的有利影響所抵銷 [TSLA_10Q_202606.html, chunk #77]。

**Magnificent Seven 股價下跌對 Tesla 的意涵：**

- 根據 Reuters 報導，對沖基金在 SpaceX IPO 前拋售了大型科技股，部分甚至增加了看空部位，「Magnificent Seven」——包括 Nvidia、Apple、Amazon、Alphabet、Meta、Tesla 與 Microsoft——自前週五以來全數下跌 [NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。
- Roundhill Magnificent Seven ETF 自 6 月 5 日以來下跌超過 2.4%，分析師指出投資人正在「清理甲板」以為 SpaceX 週五上市做準備 [NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。
- 報導中個股當日表現：NVDA 上漲 2.22%、AAPL 上漲 1.39%、AMZN 上漲 1.47%、GOOG 上漲 0.92%（此為報導當日盤中數據，非前週累計跌幅）[NVDA_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。

**Tesla 特有的股價風險因素：**

Tesla 的 10-K 文件警示，若執行長 Elon Musk 因個人貸款義務（banking institutions 要求出售持股以滿足貸款義務）、其他義務、或為履行 2018 CEO Performance Award 的稅務義務而需要出售持股，此類出售可能導致 Tesla 股價下跌 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #101]。此外，Tesla 在新技術與新產品目標方面的投資涉及長期開發時程與大量資本，若消費者需求與這些投資方向出現錯配，可能導致資產減損或策略失誤，進而影響財務表現與股價 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #101]。

**補充說明：** 來源材料未提供 Tesla 股價在 Magnificent Seven 下跌期間的具體跌幅數據，亦未提供 SpaceX IPO 對 Tesla 股價的量化影響分析。上述股價風險因素來自 Tesla 10-K 的一般性風險揭露，並非針對本次 Magnificent Seven 下跌事件的直接分析。

records.query: NVIDIA 和 Microsoft 的毛利率誰比較高？加上新聞中兩家公司在 AI 策略布局上的最新動態，兩者目前的 AI 競爭定位有何不同？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的毛利率遠高於 Microsoft，NVIDIA 的毛利率約為 71%，而 Microsoft 雖然整體營收規模龐大，但受 AI 基礎設施投資影響，雲端毛利率正面臨下滑壓力。在 AI 策略定位上，NVIDIA 專注於提供底層 AI 晶片與資料中心硬體平台，而 Microsoft 則側重於雲端服務、軟體應用整合以及發展自有 AI 模型以降低對外部實驗室的依賴。

以下為兩家公司的詳細財報數據與 AI 策略比較：

### 一、毛利率比較

**NVIDIA**
NVIDIA 的毛利率高達約 71.07%（Gross Margin: 0.71068），其營業利潤率更高達約 65.02%（Operating Margin: 0.65024），顯示其在半導體與 AI 晶片市場具有極高的定價能力與獲利能力 [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260508.txt, chunk #0] [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260519.txt, chunk #0]。

**Microsoft**
Microsoft 在 2025 會計年度的總營收為 2,817.24 億美元，總銷貨成本為 878.31 億美元 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。龐大的銷貨成本主要來自於雲端服務的擴展，導致其整體毛利率結構低於 NVIDIA。更具體而言，Microsoft 的「雲端毛利率」（Microsoft Cloud gross margin percentage）在 2025 會計年度下降至 69%，主要原因是他們正在擴大 AI 基礎設施規模，儘管部分被 Azure 的效率提升所抵銷 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。到了 2025 年 12 月 31 日止的季度，Microsoft Cloud 的毛利率進一步下降至 67%，反映其在 AI 基礎設施上的持續投資以及 AI 產品使用量的增長 [MSFT_10Q_202512.html, chunk #105]。

### 二、AI 策略與競爭定位差異

**NVIDIA：硬體平台與生態系統的提供者**
NVIDIA 將自身定位為「資料中心規模的 AI 基礎設施公司」，其競爭策略是提供涵蓋晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法的完整技術堆疊 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。該公司採用平台策略，透過其 CUDA 開發平台與數百個特定領域的軟體庫，建立龐大的開發者生態系統，藉此增加其平台的價值並支持多個數十億美元的終端市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。然而，NVIDIA 目前面臨日益激烈的 AI 晶片競爭，包括來自 Cerebras (CBRS) 推出不同架構的 AI 處理器，以及 AMD (AMD) 即將推出的伺服器系統 [NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]。此外，NVIDIA 的大型客戶如 Amazon (AMZN) 與 Google (GOOGL) 也開始向第三方客戶提供自家的 AI 晶片，其中 Amazon 的晶片業務年營收運轉率已超過 200 億美元並以三位數百分比增長，這對 NVIDIA 的市場壟力構成挑戰 [NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4]。

**Microsoft：雲端整合、應用服務與自有模型開發**
Microsoft 的 AI 策略高度圍繞其雲端平台與生產力軟體。該公司與 OpenAI 建立了長期的戰略合作夥伴關係，並在 2025 年 10 月與 2026 年 4 月延續了此合作關係，持有使用 OpenAI 智慧財產權（包含模型與基礎設施）將其整合進自家產品的權利 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #99]。Microsoft 的 AI 驅動成長主要反映在 Azure 雲端服務（2025 會計年度 Azure 營收增長 34%）與 Microsoft 365 商業雲端服務的增長 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #143]。

不過，Microsoft 最新動態顯示其策略正在微調。根據 2026 年 6 月的新聞，Microsoft 開始專注於開發七款全新的自建 AI 模型，專注於微調與成本優化，此舉標誌著該公司正試圖減少對外部前沿實驗室（如 OpenAI）AI 能力的依賴 [MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。公司已將大量圖形處理器（GPU）運算資源分配給內部研發團隊，展現其在 AI 產品組合上追求自主性的新階段 [MSFT_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #0]。儘管如此，Microsoft 也面臨 AI 投資侵蝕利潤的風險，該公司明確表示在雲端與 AI 基礎設施上的投資將持續增加營運成本並可能降低營業利潤率 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #99]。

records.query: NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河是什麼？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 的核心技術護城河在於其以 CUDA 平台為基礎、涵蓋硬體、系統、軟體、演算法與庫的完整端到端加速運算平台，以及由此形成的龐大開發者生態系統與資料中心規模協同設計能力。以下從多個面向逐一說明：

**1. CUDA 軟體平台與生態系統**

NVIDIA 的技術堆疊以 CUDA 開發平台為基礎，該平台可在所有 NVIDIA GPU 上運行，並搭配數百個特定領域的軟體庫、框架、演算法、SDK 與 API [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。全球有超過 750 萬名開發者使用 CUDA 及其他軟體工具來部署 NVIDIA 技術 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。龐大且持續增長的開發者基數與裝機量強化了 NVIDIA 的生態系統，提升了平台對客戶的價值 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

**2. 資料中心規模的協同設計（Extreme Co-design）**

NVIDIA 的資料中心規模產品具備極致的協同設計特性，即基礎設施的晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法經過整體架構與最佳化，以最大化效能與規模；數十萬顆 GPU 可互連運作為一台巨型電腦 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。Blackwell 架構的資料中心規模產品即具備此一協同設計特性 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

**3. 端到端 AI 運算平台**

NVIDIA 提供完整的端到端加速運算平台，涵蓋 AI 訓練與推論，包括全堆疊資料中心規模的運算與網路解決方案，橫跨處理單元、互連、系統與軟體 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。其運算解決方案涵蓋 AI 伺服器中的三大主要處理單元——GPU、CPU 與 DPU [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。NVIDIA AI Enterprise 軟體套件包含 NIM（提升 token 吞吐量）、NeMo（用於策展、微調、強化學習、評估與保護領域適配模型）以及 AI Blueprints（預建可執行範本，協助企業建構與部署 AI 代理）[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**4. 統一底層架構支援多元市場**

NVIDIA 採用平台策略，以統一的底層可程式架構支援多個價值數十億美元的終端市場，透過內部或第三方開發的各種軟體堆疊來滿足不同運算需求 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。此一策略使 NVIDIA 能以相同底層技術服務遊戲、資料中心、專業視覺化、汽車與機器人等多個市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20] [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。

**5. 研發投入與創新積累**

NVIDIA 自成立以來已投入超過 767 億美元於研發，產出對現代運算至關重要的發明 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。1999 年發明 GPU、2006 年推出 CUDA 開放平行運算能力、2012 年 AlexNet 在 NVIDIA GPU 上訓練並贏得 ImageNet 競賽（被視為 AI 的「大爆炸」時刻），均為關鍵里程碑 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。

**6. 生態系統合作夥伴網路**

NVIDIA 的運算平台幾乎可從所有主要伺服器製造商與雲端服務提供商（CSP）取得，也可在 NVIDIA 自有的 AI 超級電腦上使用 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。公司透過與數百所大學的合作以及透過 Inception 計畫支援數萬家新創公司來推廣 AI，並透過深度學習學院提供神經網路設計、訓練與部署的培訓 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。此外，NVIDIA 與 Tech Mahindra 合作開發 AI 驅動的電信網路營運推理代理，與 Lumentum Holdings 合作開發 AI 與資料中心的光學技術，並與 Nebius Group 建立戰略合作夥伴關係 [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260519.txt, chunk #1]。

**7. 財務實力支撐護城河**

NVIDIA 擁有強健的財務狀況，總現金達 625.6 億美元，總債務為 114.1 億美元，自由現金流為 58.13 億美元，股東權益報酬率（ROE）為 101.485%，資產報酬率為 51.188% [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260519.txt, chunk #1]。流動比率為 3.905 [NVDA_Fundamentals_20260519.txt, chunk #1]。

**8. 市場領導地位與技術優勢的持續延伸**

在遊戲領域，NVIDIA 的 GeForce RTX GPU 具備光線追蹤技術與 DLSS（深度學習超高取樣）AI 技術，Blackwell 架構引入了神經圖形技術，將 AI 模型與傳統渲染相結合 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。在汽車領域，NVIDIA 提供 DRIVE Hyperion 平台，涵蓋從雲端到車輛的全堆疊端到端自動駕駛解決方案 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。在實體 AI 領域，NVIDIA 提供涵蓋資料中心基礎設施、開放模型、系統、嵌入式運算模組與軟體堆疊的端到端平台，用於訓練、模擬與部署先進自動化與機器人解決方案 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。

records.query: NVIDIA 如何用同一套底層架構同時佈局資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用市場？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 透過一套統一的可程式化底層架構——以 GPU、CPU、CUDA 與網路技術為基礎建構模組——同時支撐資料中心、遊戲、專業視覺化與車用四大市場，再依各市場需求搭配不同的軟體堆疊，從而以同一核心技術服務多個數十億美元級的終端市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27]。

**統一底層架構與平台策略**

NVIDIA 採用平台策略，將硬體、系統、軟體、演算法、函式庫、AI 模型與訓練資料集及服務整合在一起，為所服務的市場創造獨特價值 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。雖然各終端市場的運算需求各異，NVIDIA 以統一的可程式化架構加以因應，讓公司能以相同的底層技術支撐數個數十億美元級的終端市場，並透過內部或第三方開發者與合作夥伴開發的多種軟體堆疊來滿足不同需求 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。這種可程式化架構讓 NVIDIA 能在研發上進行槓桿式投資：以共享的底層技術支援多個市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #27]。NVIDIA 的運算解決方案涵蓋 AI 伺服器中的三大主要處理單元——GPU、CPU 與 DPU [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**資料中心市場**

NVIDIA 的資料中心平台專注於加速運算密集型工作負載，如 AI、資料處理、圖形、機器人技術與科學運算，相較於傳統僅用 CPU 的方案提供更佳的總持有成本 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。該平台以機架級系統、子系統或模組形式交付，包含高效能、節能的 GPU、CPU、互連技術與完整優化的 AI 及 HPC 軟體堆疊 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。網路產品包括 NVLink 互連與交換器、InfiniBand 與 Ethernet 的端對端平台 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #24]。NVIDIA 在 2024 年推出 Blackwell 架構，將 36 顆 Grace CPU 與 72 顆 Blackwell GPU 連接於資料中心規模的液冷設計中，用於即時兆參數推論與訓練 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。2026 會計年度推出並擴展 Blackwell Ultra 平台，針對 agentic AI、reasoning 與 physical AI 進行優化，相較 Hopper 世代帶來顯著的 token 吞吐量提升與每 token 成本降低 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。Blackwell 架構引入了極致協同設計（extreme co-design），將基礎設施的晶片、網路、系統、軟體與演算法進行整體架構與優化，數十萬顆 GPU 可互連為一台巨型電腦 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。NVIDIA 亦提供 NVIDIA AI Enterprise 軟體套件，包含 NIM（提升 token 吞吐量）、NeMo（用於模型策展、微調與評估）與 AI Blueprints（預建可執行範本）等工具 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**遊戲市場**

NVIDIA 的遊戲產品包括 GeForce RTX GPU（用於遊戲桌機與筆電 PC）、GeForce NOW 雲端遊戲服務，以及遊戲主機的 SoC 與開發服務 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。RTX GPU 具備光線追蹤技術與深度學習超高取樣（DLSS）AI 技術，後者透過新的 transformer 模型架構提升遊戲幀率並生成高品質影像 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。RTX GPU 同時搭載 NVIDIA tensor core 技術，使其適合加速新一代裝置端 AI 應用 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。2025 會計年度，NVIDIA 發表 Blackwell GeForce RTX 50 系列桌機與筆電 GPU，引入結合 AI 模型與傳統渲染的神經圖形技術 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。2026 會計年度，NVIDIA 為遊戲與 GeForce NOW 推出並擴展 Blackwell 架構 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。Blackwell GPU 的先進 AI 與神經渲染能力結合 NVIDIA 的 AI 軟體堆疊，顯著加速在 PC 上本地運行的 AI 工作負載 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**專業視覺化市場**

NVIDIA 透過與獨立軟體供應商（ISV）合作，將其產品針對 NVIDIA GPU 進行優化，服務專業視覺化市場 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。GPU 運算平台為設計、工程與數位內容創作等關鍵工作流程提升生產力並引入新能力 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。隨著生成式與 agentic AI 應用日益增多，RTX PRO GPU 的增強 AI 與資料處理能力需求也隨之上升，這些 GPU 使用與資料中心解決方案相同的 Tensor Core 技術 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。NVIDIA 的電腦圖形平台從開發者工具、雲端服務到所有 RTX 級 GPU 內含的 Tensor Core，端對端地運用 AI [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。Omniverse 是即時 3D 設計協作與虛擬世界模擬軟體，讓藝術家、設計師與創作者連接並協作於領先的設計應用中 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

**車用市場**

NVIDIA 的車用業務涵蓋從雲端到車輛的自動駕駛平台解決方案，在 DRIVE Hyperion 平台下提供端對端全棧解決方案 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。該平台包含開發基礎設施、高效能節能的 DRIVE AGX 運算硬體、運行車內作業系統（DRIVE OS）、支援全自動駕駛的參考感測器套件，以及用於自動駕駛、地圖建構與停車服務的開放模組化 DRIVE 軟體平台 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。NVIDIA 在 2018 年推出首款自駕系統單晶片（system-on-chips, or SoC）[NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。針對 physical AI，NVIDIA 提供端對端平台，涵蓋資料中心基礎設施、開放模型、系統、嵌入式運算模組與軟體堆疊，用於訓練、模擬與部署先進自動化與機器人解決方案 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26]。NVIDIA 亦建立了 NVIDIA DRIVE 軟體堆疊用於自動駕駛 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。

**生態系與研發投入**

NVIDIA 自成立以來已投入超過 767 億美元於研發 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20]。全球有超過 750 萬名開發者使用 CUDA 及其他軟體工具 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。NVIDIA 的運算平台幾乎可從所有主要伺服器製造商與雲端服務供應商取得 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。公司超過半數的工程師從事軟體工作 [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21]。NVIDIA 透過與數百所大學的合作及透過 Inception 計畫與數萬家新創公司合作來推廣 AI [NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28]。

records.query: Microsoft 如何把 Copilot 整合進 Microsoft 365 的產品策略？
records.answer:
Microsoft 將 Copilot 納入 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端服務的產品組合中，作為該平台 AI 驅動的生產力與業務解決方案的一部分，並透過持續在核心產品與服務中新增 AI 工具與代理式場景來推動成長 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

以下是來源中可找到的具體整合層面：

**1. 產品組合中的定位**
Microsoft 365 Commercial 被描述為「AI 驅動的業務與生產力解決方案平台」，將 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 與 Enterprise Mobility + Security 整合在一起，協助組織賦能員工 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。Microsoft 365 Copilot 明確被列為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端服務的組成項目之一 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52] [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #101]。

**2. 透過 AI 功能推動成長策略**
微軟的成長策略取決於在核心產品與服務中新增 AI 工具、功能與代理式場景（agentic scenarios），涵蓋通訊、協作、分析、安全、合規及其他 AI 業務生產力類別 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。同樣地，在消費者端，Microsoft 365 Consumer 的成長也依賴於以新功能（包括 AI 工具）為核心產品組合增加價值 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

**3. 搜尋與廣告領域的 Copilot**
Microsoft Copilot 也被定位為「數位伴侶」，旨在提供資訊、娛樂與啟發，並與 Microsoft Edge 瀏覽器及 Bing 搜尋引擎整合，作為使用者獲取與互動的關鍵工具 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。

**4. 硬體產品中的 Copilot+ PCs**
微軟設計並銷售包含 Copilot+ PCs 在內的 Surface 裝置，這些裝置的設計目的是讓人們與組織能透過 Windows 及整合的微軟產品與服務連結到最重要的人與內容 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。來源中提及 Surface 產品線包含 Copilot+ PCs，但未進一步說明 Copilot+ PCs 具體整合了哪些 AI 功能。

**5. 生態系中的 Copilot 採用**
根據生態系合作夥伴 AvePoint 的觀察，AvePoint 協助客戶完成 Purview、E5 與 Copilot 等「最後一哩」的工作負載採用 [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2]。該合作夥伴指出，目前 Copilot 的滲透率約為 5%，E5 滲透率仍低於 20%，顯示仍有成長空間 [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2]。此外，AvePoint 的 AgentPulse 產品可協助客戶發現跨雲端環境（如 Gemini 和 Copilot）中運行的 AI 代理，控制其可存取的系統與資料，監控權杖消耗，並在需要時關閉代理 [MSFT_News_20260612_03.txt, chunk #2]。

records.query: Microsoft 如何靠 Windows 帶動雲端與 Copilot 相關服務的參與度？
records.answer:
Microsoft 透過將 Windows 作為推動其雲端業務與提升多項服務參與度的引擎，讓使用者更頻繁地接觸到 Copilot、Microsoft Edge、Bing 與 Microsoft Teams 等服務 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。

具體而言，Microsoft 在其未來機會的戰略布局中明確指出，公司正利用 Windows 來推動雲端業務的增長、擴大 PC 市場的市占率，並提升使用者對 Microsoft Edge、Bing、Copilot、Microsoft Teams、Microsoft 365 Consumer 以及 Xbox Game Pass 等服務的參與度 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49]。這顯示 Windows 作業系統在 Microsoft 的戰略中，不僅是底層平台，更是引導使用者進入其雲端與 AI 服務生態的關鍵入口。

在產品組合的層面上，Windows Commercial 的雲端部分被直接整合於 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端服務中，該雲端服務還包含 Microsoft 365 Copilot、Enterprise Mobility + Security、Exchange、SharePoint 以及 Microsoft Teams 等核心產品 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52] [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #101]。這意味著作為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 訂閱用戶，客戶將同時獲得 Windows Commercial 雲端部分與 Copilot 等服務，兩者在商業產品組合中是綁定提供的 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52]。

從實際的財務表現與成長動能來看，Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入的增長確實受到 Windows Commercial 等組件的帶動。在截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的九個月期間，Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品與雲端服務收入增加了 106 億美元（增幅 17%），其中 Microsoft 365 Commercial 雲端收入增長了 18%，此增長主要歸因於 Microsoft 365 E5 與 Microsoft 365 Copilot 帶動的每用戶平均收入增長，以及持續的 Microsoft 365 Commercial 席位增長 [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109]。此外，Windows Commercial 的內部部署組件也隨著 Microsoft 365 套件銷售的增長而推動了 Microsoft 365 Commercial 產品收入成長 10% [MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #109]。

在消費端，Microsoft 設計的 Surface 裝置（包括 Copilot+ PCs）旨在讓人們與組織能使用 Windows 與整合的 Microsoft 產品和服務連結到對他們最重要的人與內容，進而幫助組織、學生與消費者提升生產力 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。這進一步說明 Microsoft 透過搭載 Windows 的第一方硬體裝置，將使用者引導至其整合的雲端與 Copilot 服務體驗中 [MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #57]。

•Reinvent productivity and business processes to help organizations and individuals work and collaborate more securely and efficiently. •Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform to provide a foundation for our customers’ digital workloads including hybrid consistency, developer productivity, data and AI capabilities, and trusted security and compliance. •Create more personal computing to enable users to interact with technology in more intuitive, engaging, and dynamic ways. Growth in Devices is dependent on total PC shipments, the ability to attract new customers, our product roadmap, and expanding into new categories. Gaming

Microsoft is expanding how billions of people globally access and play video games on PC, console, mobile, and cloud. Our game content is developed through a collection of first-party studios creating iconic and differentiated gaming experiences. We continue to invest in gaming studios and content to expand our intellectual property roadmap and leverage new content creators. These unique gaming experiences are the cornerstone of Xbox Game Pass, a subscription service and gaming community with access to a curated library of first- and third-party titles. The gamer remains at the heart of the Xbox ecosystem. We are identifying new opportunities to attract gamers across a variety of different end points through our first- and third-party content and business diversification across subscriptions, ads, and digital stores. We’ve seen new devices from third-party manufacturers along with key PC and mobile end points that help us empower gamers to play in a way that is most convenient to them. We are focused on growing the platform and expanding to new ecosystems to engage as many gamers as possible. Xbox enables people to connect and share online gaming experiences that are accessible on Xbox consoles, Windows-enabled devices, and other devices. Xbox is designed to benefit users by providing access to a network of certified applications and services and to benefit our developer and partner ecosystems by providing access to a large customer base. Xbox revenue is mainly affected by subscriptions and sales of first- and third-party content, as well as advertising. Growth of our Gaming business is determined by the overall active user base through Xbox enabled content, availability of games, providing exclusive game content that gamers seek, the computational power and reliability of the devices used to access our content and services, and the ability to create new experiences. Search and News Advertising

Our Search and news advertising business is designed to deliver relevant search, native, and display advertising to a global audience. Microsoft Copilot is a digital companion designed to inform, entertain, and inspire. Our Microsoft Edge browser and Bing search engine with Copilot are key tools to enable user acquisition and engagement, while our technology platform enables accelerated delivery of digital advertising solutions. In addition to first-party tools, we have several partnerships with companies through which we provide and monetize search offerings.

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Our reportable segments are described below. Productivity and Business Processes

Our Productivity and Business Processes segment consists of products and services in our portfolio of productivity, communication, and information services, spanning a variety of devices and platforms. This segment primarily comprises:

•Microsoft 365 Commercial products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Commercial cloud, comprising Microsoft 365 Commercial, Enterprise Mobility + Security, the cloud portion of Windows Commercial, the per-user portion of Power BI, Exchange, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365 Security and Compliance, and Microsoft 365 Copilot; and Microsoft 365 Commercial products, comprising Windows Commercial on-premises and Office licensed on-premises. •Microsoft 365 Consumer products and cloud services, including Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions, Office licensed on-premises, and other consumer services. •LinkedIn, including Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. •Dynamics products and cloud services, including Dynamics 365, comprising a set of intelligent, cloud-based applications across ERP, CRM, Power Apps, and Power Automate; and on-premises ERP and CRM applications. Microsoft 365 Commercial Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Commercial is an AI-powered business and productivity solutions platform that brings together Office, Windows, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Enterprise Mobility + Security to help organizations empower their employees. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users in new markets such as frontline workers, small and medium businesses, and growth markets, as well as add AI-enabled tools, features, and agentic scenarios to our core product and service offerings across communication, collaboration, analytics, security, compliance, and other AI business productivity categories. Microsoft 365 Commercial revenue is mainly affected by a combination of continued installed base growth and average revenue per user expansion, as well as the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365. Microsoft 365 Consumer Products and Cloud Services

Microsoft 365 Consumer is designed to increase personal productivity and creativity through a range of products and services. Growth depends on our ability to reach new users, add value to our core product set with new features including AI tools, and continue to expand our product and service offerings into new markets. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue and Office Consumer products revenue is mainly affected by the percentage of customers that buy Office with their new devices and the continued shift from Office licensed on-premises to Microsoft 365 Consumer subscriptions. Microsoft 365 Consumer cloud revenue is also affected by the demand for communication and storage through Outlook.com and OneDrive, which is largely driven by subscriptions and advertising. LinkedIn

LinkedIn connects the world’s professionals to make them more productive and successful and transforms the way companies hire, market, sell, and learn. In addition to LinkedIn’s free services, LinkedIn offers monetized solutions designed to offer AI-enabled insights and productivity: Talent Solutions, Marketing Solutions, Premium Subscriptions, and Sales Solutions. Growth will depend on our ability to increase LinkedIn member engagement on the platform and our ability to continue offering insight and AI-enabled services that provide value for our members and customers. LinkedIn revenue is mainly affected by demand from enterprises and professionals for subscriptions to Talent Solutions, Sales Solutions, and Premium Subscriptions offerings, as well as member engagement and the quality of the sponsored content delivered to those members to drive Marketing Solutions. Dynamics Products and Cloud Services

Dynamics provides cloud-based and on-premises business solutions for financial management, enterprise resource planning (“ERP”), customer relationship management (“CRM”), and supply chain management, as well as agentic AI and other low code application development platforms, for small and medium businesses, large organizations, and divisions of global enterprises. Dynamics revenue is driven by the number of users licensed and applications consumed, expansion of average revenue per user, and the continued shift to Dynamics 365, a unified set of cloud-based intelligent business applications, including our low code development platforms, such as Power Apps and Power Automate. Competition

Competitors to Office include software and global application vendors, web-based and mobile application companies, AI-first application companies, as well as local application developers.

[MSFT] Microsoft Relationship Seen as Complementary
Asked about investor concerns over Microsoft concentration, Jiang said AvePoint has operated in the Microsoft ecosystem for more than 20 years but does not depend on Microsoft as a reseller. He said Microsoft does not resell AvePoint’s products, and AvePoint helps customers complete “last mile” adoption of workloads such as Purview, E5 and Copilot. Jiang said AvePoint is also active in the Google, Salesforce and AWS ecosystems as customers become increasingly multi-cloud. He said AvePoint is complementary to hyperscalers because it helps customers manage different license types and workloads across multiple platforms. On Microsoft 365 backup, Jiang said Microsoft Office Cloud has roughly 400 million to 500 million user seats, while AvePoint covers “tens of millions” of seats and is not yet at 100 million. He said the company still sees room for growth, while also incorporating Microsoft’s Backup Express snapshot capability into its own backup stack. Jiang said many customers use a mix of license levels, noting that E5 penetration remains below 20% and Copilot penetration is about 5%, according to his comments. He said AvePoint helps customers maximize existing investments rather than pushing them toward the highest-cost licenses. Multi-Cloud Expansion and SaaS Model
Jiang said AvePoint expects non-Microsoft revenue to rise to more than 30% of its mix as the company pursues its goal of reaching $1 billion in annual recurring revenue. He said non-Microsoft revenue is currently less than 10%. He said the company already has product coverage across ecosystems including Google, Salesforce, Atlassian, ServiceNow and AWS, but go-to-market development takes time because each ecosystem has different partners and channels. Jiang also highlighted AvePoint’s SaaS-heavy model. He said 88% of revenue is recurring and that AvePoint runs on hyperscaler infrastructure across GCP, Azure, AWS and U.S. government data centers. He said hyperscaler contracts help shield AvePoint from hardware supply-chain shocks and pricing volatility. “We are a true SaaS company that’s asset light,” Jiang said. Control Suite and AgentPulse
Kessinger asked Jiang to clarify AvePoint’s role in governance and security. Jiang said the company’s roots in enterprise content management mean it manages the lifecycle of unstructured data, from ingestion, migration, classification and tagging to backup, ransomware recovery and governance. Jiang said these capabilities are increasingly important in the AI era because AI can accelerate access and data-management problems. He said AvePoint competes across areas that had previously been separate, including migration, backup, governance and data security posture management. Jiang also discussed AvePoint AgentPulse, which he said became generally available in the first quarter after a preview late last year. He said AgentPulse helps customers discover AI agents running across cloud environments such as Gemini and Copilot, control what systems and data they can access, monitor token consumption and shut agents down when needed. Jiang said AgentPulse is monetized through AvePoint’s “best” Control bundle and is helping increase Control deal sizes. He said Control represents about 40% of the company’s pipeline, compared with 26% of blended revenue contribution last year, while resiliency remains close to 60%. Intelligent Cloud

Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that power modern business and developers. This segment primarily comprises:

•Server products and cloud services, including Azure and other cloud services, comprising cloud and AI consumption-based services, GitHub cloud services, Nuance Healthcare cloud services, virtual desktop offerings, and other cloud services; and Server products, comprising SQL Server, Windows Server, Visual Studio, System Center, related Client Access Licenses, and other on-premises offerings. •Enterprise and partner services, including Enterprise Support Services, Industry Solutions, Nuance professional services, Microsoft Partner Network, and Learning Experience. More Personal Computing

Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology. This segment primarily comprises:

•Windows and Devices, including Windows OEM licensing (Windows Pro and non-Pro licenses sold through the OEM channel) and Devices, comprising Surface and PC accessories. •Gaming, including Xbox hardware and Xbox content and services, comprising first- and third-party content (including games and in-game content), Xbox Game Pass and other subscriptions, Xbox Cloud Gaming, advertising, and other cloud services. •Search advertising (formerly Search and news advertising), comprising Bing, Copilot, Microsoft News, Microsoft Edge, and third-party affiliates. Revenue and costs are generally directly attributed to our segments.

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Azure’s competitive advantage includes enabling a hybrid cloud, allowing deployment of existing datacenters with our public cloud into a single, cohesive infrastructure, and the ability to run at a scale that meets the needs of businesses of all sizes and complexities. Our AI offerings compete with AI products from hyperscalers, as well as products from other emerging competitors and other open source offerings, many of which are also current or potential partners. Our Azure Security offerings include our cloud security solution and security information and event management solution, which compete with providers in the cybersecurity and cloud security space. We believe our cloud’s global scale, coupled with our broad portfolio of identity and security solutions, allows us to effectively solve complex cybersecurity challenges for our customers and differentiates us from the competition. Our server products face competition from a wide variety of server operating systems and applications offered by companies with a range of market approaches. Vertically integrated computer manufacturers offer their own versions of the Unix operating system preinstalled on server hardware and nearly all computer manufacturers offer server hardware for the Linux operating system. We compete to provide enterprise-wide computing and point solutions with numerous commercial software vendors that offer solutions and middleware technology platforms, software applications for connectivity, security, hosting, database, and e-business servers. Our database, business intelligence, and data warehousing solutions offerings compete with products from providers in the data and analytics industry. Our system management solutions compete with server management and server virtualization platform providers. Our products for software developers compete against offerings from major technology providers, as well as open source alternatives. We believe our server products provide customers with advantages in performance, total costs of ownership, and productivity by delivering superior applications, development tools, compatibility with a broad base of hardware and software applications, security, and manageability. Our Enterprise and partner services business competes with a wide range of companies that provide strategy and business planning, application development, and infrastructure services, including multinational consulting firms and small niche businesses focused on specific technologies. More Personal Computing

Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology. This segment primarily comprises:

•Windows and Devices, including Windows OEM licensing (Windows Pro and non-Pro licenses sold through the OEM channel) and Devices, comprising Surface and PC accessories. •Gaming, including Xbox hardware and Xbox content and services, comprising first- and third-party content (including games and in-game content), Xbox Game Pass and other subscriptions, Xbox Cloud Gaming, advertising, and other cloud services. •Search and news advertising, comprising Bing and Copilot, Microsoft News, Microsoft Edge, and third-party affiliates. Windows and Devices

The Windows operating system is designed to deliver a more personal computing experience for users by enabling consistency of experience, applications, and information across their devices. Windows OEM revenue is impacted significantly by the number of Windows operating system licenses purchased by OEMs, which they pre-install on the devices they sell. In addition to computing device market volume, Windows OEM revenue is impacted by: 

•The mix of computing devices based on form factor and screen size. •Differences in device market demand between developed markets and growth markets. •Growth of the AI PC category. •Attachment of Windows to devices shipped. •Customer mix between consumer, small and medium businesses, and large enterprises. •Changes in inventory levels in the OEM channel. •Pricing changes and promotions, pricing variation that occurs when the mix of devices manufactured shifts from local and regional system builders to large multinational OEMs, and different pricing of Windows versions licensed. •Constraints in the supply chain of device components.

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 的投資策略核心是持續大幅增加技術與基礎設施支出，以支援 AWS 雲端服務及人工智慧（AI）與機器學習（ML）等長期成長計畫，並預期相關支出將隨時間進一步增加 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215]。以下從基礎設施資本投入、資產規模擴張、折舊攤提變化，以及 AI 與新興技術布局等層面說明：

**基礎設施資本投入**

Amazon 明確表示，預期技術與基礎設施支出將隨時間增加，以支援新增基礎設設施與員工，包括 AI 與 ML 相關計畫 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215]。AWS 段的淨新增固定資產（property and equipment）在 2023 年為 $24,843 百萬、2024 年為 $53,267 百萬、2025 年為 $96,496 百萬，呈現逐年大幅攀升的趨勢 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。截至 2025 年 Q3 的單季與九個月累計淨新增固定資產亦較 2024 年同期顯著增加 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #56]。

**資產規模擴張**

AWS 段的固定資產淨額從 2023 年底的 $72,701 百萬增至 2024 年底的 $110,683 百萬，再大幅增至 2025 年底的 $190,055 百萬 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，AWS 固定資產淨額為 $165,106 百萬 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #56]。AWS 段資產總額亦從 2024 年底的 $155,953 百萬增至 2025 年底的 $252,588 百萬 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。

**折舊與攤銷費用**

AWS 段的折舊與攤銷費用從 2024 年的 $13,320 百萬增至 2025 年的 $21,450 百萬 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #121]。2025 年技術與基礎設施成本較前一年增加的主因為基礎設施支出上升，包含折舊與攤銷 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215]。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 面臨的反壟斷與監管風險涵蓋多個層面，包括壟斷與價格操縱訴訟、政府對電商與 AWS 雲端服務的競爭調查、資料隱私監管，以及中國與印度的外資與行業准入限制。

**一、反壟斷與競爭法訴訟**

自 2020 年 3 月起，私人訴訟當事人、各州檢察長及美國聯邦貿易委員會（FTC）在美國、加拿大和英國提起多起訴訟，指控 Amazon 涉及與供應商及第三方賣家之間的價格操縱安排、濫用市場支配地位、壟斷及企圖壟斷，以及消費者保護和不當得利等違反聯邦與州反壟斷法、州消費者保護法及加拿大和英國反壟斷法的行為 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99]。這些訴訟尋求數十億美元的損害賠償、三倍賠償、懲罰性賠償、禁令救濟、結構性救濟、民事罰款及律師費用 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99]。部分案件指控 Amazon 在線上超級商店、市集服務或中介服務市場擁有壟斷地位，並非法從事與定價政策、Featured Offers 選擇、賣家資料使用、廣告行為、Prime 結構及自有產品推廣相關的反競爭行為 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99]。在美國，Amazon 的大部分撤銷動議僅部分獲准，但每起案件中至少有部分訴求存活；在英國已有兩起集體訴訟通過認證，第三起尚在認證前階段；在美國已有一起集體訴訟通過認證，另有三起尚在認證前階段 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #99]。

**二、政府調查與監管審查**

Amazon 面臨多項公開調查，指控其業務的某些方面違反競爭相關或消費者保護規則，包括 Amazon 商店的營運（涵蓋其物流網絡和 Prime）以及 AWS 雲端服務的某些方面 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。此外，Amazon 面臨日益增長的資料收集、使用和揭露法規的調查，相關法規解釋持續演變，導致監管機構如何看待其隱私做法存在不確定性 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。監管機構和立法者越來越關注透過現有法規和新法規來控制被其歸類為線上「守門人」的科技公司營運，這增加了 Amazon 的合規成本並限制了業務營運 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。不利的法規、法律、決定或解釋可能導致巨額成本、民事與刑事責任或罰款、產品和服務需求減少、經營成本增加、被迫以不利方式改變業務做法、聲譽損害及阻礙成長 [AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156]。

**三、訴訟與監管程序的廣泛範圍**

作為一家在全球提供廣泛消費者和企業產品與服務的創新公司，Amazon 定期面臨涉及專利及其他智慧財產權、稅務、勞工與就業（包括配送司機的分類）、競爭與反壟斷、隱私、資料使用、資料保護、資料安全、資料本地化、網路安全、消費者保護、商業糾紛、由 Amazon 及第三方提供的商品與服務（包括人工智慧技術與服務）、醫療保健等事項的實際與威脅性訴訟、調查及其他程序 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #115]。隨著業務在範圍和地理覆蓋方面的擴張，以及產品和服務變得更複雜，政府和監管機構尋求以預防性方式對 Amazon 進行監管，此類程序的數量和規模隨時間增加 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #115]。這些程序的結果本質上不可預測，可能涉及要求 Amazon 支付大筆未來款項、停止提供某些產品或服務、以不利方式改變業務做法、開發不侵權或替代產品或技術的許可、制裁、同意令或命令 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #115]。

**四、中國與印度的國際監管風險**

中國（PRC）和印度透過法規和許可要求監管 Amazon 及其關聯公司在當地的業務，可能限制外國投資與網路、IT 基礎設施、資料中心、零售、配送等領域的營運，以及網路內容和媒體產品與服務的銷售 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #93]。為滿足中國的所有權、監管許可和網路安全要求，Amazon 透過與持有 PRC 許可的第三方的合約關係提供某些技術服務 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #93]。在印度，政府限制外國實體對涉及線上多品牌零售交易的印度公司的所有權或控制權；對於 www.amazon.in，Amazon 向第三方賣家提供行銷工具和物流服務，並持有一個在該市集上作為第三方賣家的實體的間接少數股權 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #93]。雖然 Amazon 認為這些結構和活動符合現有法律，但它們涉及獨特風險，且 PRC 和印度可能不時考慮並實施額外的監管、許可或其他要求的變更，可能影響這些結構和活動 [AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #93]。

**五、FTC 和解的財務影響**

在 2025 年第三季度，Amazon 的營業利潤中計入了 25 億美元與 FTC 訴訟和解相關的費用，以及 18 億美元主要與計畫中的職位裁減相關的預估遣散成本 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #75]。North America 營業利潤從 2024 年第三季度的 56.63 億美元下降至 2025 年第三季度的 47.89 億美元，其下降主要歸因於增加的其他營運、物流、技術和基礎設施以及運輸成本，其中包含 FTC 和解與遣散成本，部分被增加的單位銷售和廣告銷售所抵消 [AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #75]。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過將 Gemini 模型嵌入搜尋體驗、雲端服務以及所有擁有五億以上用戶的產品中，實現了 AI 在整個產品生態系的全面整合。 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]

以下是各個整合層面的具體說明：

**1. Google 搜尋的 AI 整合**
Google 將 Gemini 的先進推理、思考與多模態能力導入搜尋功能，推出了「AI Mode」，讓使用者能提出過去需要多次搜尋才能解答的更細微問題 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。此外，「AI Overviews」功能讓使用者更容易向 Google 提問並獲得有用的回應，而大型語言模型也大幅改善了使用者能提出的問題類型與結果品質 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。搜尋的相關流量也包含了透過搜尋分眾合作夥伴（search distribution partners）產生的收入，這些合作夥伴在瀏覽器、工具列等處使用 Google.com 作為預設搜尋 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #31] [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #38]。

**2. 產品生態系的全面嵌入**
Google 目前所有 15 項擁有五億以上用戶的產品（其中包括 7 項擁有二十億用戶的產品）都已使用 Gemini 模型 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Gemini 3 具備先進的多模態理解能力，支援產品生態系中的視覺化呈現與互動式使用者體驗，包括搜尋與 Gemini 應用程式 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**3. Google Cloud 與企業服務**
針對雲端客戶，Google 提供了「Gemini Enterprise」與「Gemini for Google Workspace」等解決方案，協助企業保持創新前沿 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Google Cloud Platform 提供包含企業 AI 基礎架構、Vertex AI 平台以及 Gemini Enterprise 在內的 AI 服務 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #31] [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #38]。Google Workspace 則將 Gemini 功能整合至 Gmail、Docs、Calendar、Drive 與 Meet 等雲端協作工具中 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #31] [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #38]。

**4. 消費者訂閱服務**
Google 的消費者訂閱服務（如 YouTube TV、YouTube Music and Premium、NFL Sunday Ticket）以及 Google One，皆提供使用者存取 Google 最強大 Gemini 模型的途徑 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #31] [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #38] [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。

**5. 廣告產品的 AI 應用**
Google 搜尋與其他 Google 擁有及營運的物業（如 Gmail、Google Maps、Google Play）透過付費點擊（paid clicks）與每次點擊成本（cost-per-click）等指標來追蹤廣告流量變現 [GOOGL_10Q_202603.html, chunk #31] [GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #38]。Google 建立了世界級的廣告技術，且 AI 在其廣告業務中已作為基礎超過十年 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。產品如 Demand Gen、Performance Max 與 Product Studio 皆運用 Google AI 的全部能力，協助廣告商發掘未開發與遞增的轉換機會 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] Table of Contents

Alphabet Inc. Making AI Helpful for Everyone

We believe AI is a profound platform shift that can bring meaningful and positive change to people and societies across the world, and to our business. We aim to build the most advanced, safe, and responsible AI through our full-stack approach, which spans AI-optimized infrastructure; world-class research, including models and tooling; and our products and platforms that bring AI to billions of people, developers, and enterprises. At the foundation of our full-stack approach is our AI-optimized infrastructure — a key differentiator enabling us to power our own products, such as Search and YouTube, and support the services we provide to our Google Cloud customers. Our technical infrastructure allows us to use and offer our customers a range of AI accelerator options, including specialized Graphics Processing Units (GPUs) and our own custom-built Tensor Processing Units (TPUs), such as Ironwood, our seventh-generation TPU. We are focused on driving efficiencies in our data centers, allowing us to leverage our technical infrastructure to deliver our products and services at an increasing scale while simultaneously enabling world-class research and model development. Over the last decade, our research teams have pushed the boundaries of AI forward, which is displayed through Gemini 3, our most intelligent AI model yet. Designed to deliver advanced multimodal understanding, Gemini 3 represents our most capable iteration of agentic and generative coding technologies. Gemini 3 integrates enhanced reasoning capabilities to support visualizations and interactive user experiences across our product ecosystem, including Search and the Gemini app. As technology continues to improve rapidly, we are focused on bringing our latest AI advances to our products and platforms. We continue to help our users access information and knowledge, express themselves, and get things done by embedding the power of generative AI and Gemini into our products and platforms. Today, all 15 of our half-billion-user products — including seven with two billion users — use our Gemini models. For our Google Cloud customers, our offerings are helping organizations stay at the forefront of innovation with solutions such as Gemini Enterprise and Gemini for Google Workspace. Guided by our AI principles, we believe our approach to AI must be both bold and responsible.

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] Table of Contents

Alphabet Inc. Our products and services have come a long way since the company was founded more than 25 years ago. While Google Search started as a way to find web pages, organized into ten blue links, we have driven technical advancements and product innovations that have transformed Google Search into a dynamic, multimodal experience. Large language models have made it possible to express more natural language queries, vastly improving the types of questions users can ask, and the quality of results. For example, AI Overviews makes it easier to ask Google anything and get a helpful response. AI Mode allows users to ask more nuanced questions that might have previously taken multiple searches, using Gemini’s advanced reasoning, thinking, and multimodal capabilities. This drive to make information more accessible and helpful has led us over the years to improve the discovery and creation of digital content both on the web and through platforms like Google Play and YouTube.

[GOOGL 10-K period 2025] Fueling all of these great digital experiences are extraordinary platforms and devices. That is why we continue to invest in platforms like our Android mobile operating system, Chrome browser, and Chrome operating system, as well as our family of devices. We see tremendous potential for devices to be helpful and make people's lives easier by combining the best of our AI, software, and hardware. This potential is reflected in our latest generation of devices, such as the new Pixel 10 series and the Pixel Watch 4. Creating products and services that people rely on every day is a journey that we are investing in for the long-term. How We Make Money

We have built world-class advertising technologies for advertisers, agencies, and publishers to power their digital marketing businesses. Our advertising solutions help millions of companies grow their businesses through our wide range of products across devices and formats, and we aim to ensure positive user experiences by serving the right ads at the right time and by building deep partnerships with brands and agencies. AI has been foundational to our advertising business for more than a decade. Products like Demand Gen, Performance Max, and Product Studio use the full power of our AI to help advertisers find untapped and incremental conversion opportunities. Google Services generates revenues primarily by delivering both performance and brand advertising that appears on Google Search & other properties, YouTube, and Google Network partners' properties ("Google Network properties"). We continue to invest in both performance and brand advertising and seek to improve the measurability of advertising so advertisers understand the effectiveness of their campaigns. •Performance advertising creates and delivers relevant ads that users will click on leading to direct engagement with advertisers. Performance advertising lets our advertisers connect with users while driving measurable results. Our ads tools allow performance advertisers to create simple text-based ads. •Brand advertising helps enhance users' awareness of and affinity for advertisers' products and services, through videos, text, images, and other interactive ads that run across various devices. We help brand advertisers deliver digital videos and other types of ads to specific audiences for their brand-building marketing campaigns. We have allocated substantial resources to stopping bad advertising practices and protecting users on the web. We focus on creating the best advertising experiences for our users and advertisers in many ways, including filtering out invalid traffic, removing billions of bad ads from our systems every year, and closely monitoring the sites, apps, and videos where ads appear and blocklisting them when necessary to ensure that ads do not fund bad content. records.query: Google 搜尋如何演變出 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode 來回應生成式 AI 對搜尋的衝擊？
records.answer:
Google 搜尋透過引入 AI Overviews 與 AI Mode，將原本「十個藍色連結」的網頁清單轉變為動態、多模態的搜尋體驗，讓使用者能用更自然的語言提問並獲得有幫助的回應 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

以下為具體演變的各個面向：

**1. 從靜態連結到動態多模態體驗**
Google 搜尋最初只是一個協助使用者尋找網頁的工具，將結果組織為十個藍色連結；透過技術推進與產品創新，Google 已將搜尋轉變為動態、多模態的體驗 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

**2. 大型語言模型改變查詢方式**
大型語言模型讓使用者能夠表達更自然的語言查詢，大幅改善了使用者可以提出的問題類型以及結果的品質 [GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]。

**3. AI Overviews 的功能**

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的長期願景是打造「人類連結的未來」與其背後的技術，核心方向是將產品從二維螢幕推向沉浸式體驗（如擴增實境與虛擬實境）以建立下一代運算平台，並透過創新 AI 技術（包含發展超越人類智慧的「超級智慧」）來推動從家庭應用到全新平台的變革性體驗 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

在具體的投資方向與財務配置上，Meta 的策略涵蓋以下幾個關鍵面向：

**1. AI 與家庭應用的核心投資**
Meta 將多數資源投入於「家庭應用」的發展。在 2025 年，其總成本與費用的 82% 認列於 FoA，18% 認列於 RL [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。FoA 的投資金額在 2025 年達到 962.9 億美元，主要用於人力、資料中心與技術基礎設施，以開發應用程式與廣告服務 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。這些 AI 投資支援了多項倡議，包括為內容排序的系統、推薦相關內容的探索引擎、廣告客戶工具、生成式 AI 體驗，以及提升產品開發效率的相關工具 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。Meta 預期其 AI 倡議將需要大幅增加對基礎設施的投資 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #209]。在 2026 年，Meta 計畫專注於幾個關鍵投資領域：AI、Reels 與探索引擎、穿戴式裝置、產品與服務的變現、年輕族群、平台完整性與社群支援，以及基礎設施容量 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。

**2. Reality Labs 的長期前沿研發**
在 Reality Labs (RL) 方面，Meta 在 2025 年的總投資為 214 億美元，用於開發虛擬實境、擴增實境裝置、社交平台軟體、神經介面及其他基礎技術 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。許多 RL 投資指向長期的尖端研發，相關產品可能要到未來十年才能完全實現 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #130]。Meta 預期 RL 部門在可預見的未來將持續虧損運作 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。根據資料來源，RL 部門使整體營業利潤減少了約 191.9 億美元，且 Meta 預期其 2026 年的 RL 營業虧損將與 2025 年保持相似 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #302]。Meta 支持這些 RL 計畫的能力，取決於其能否從其他業務領域產生足夠的利潤 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #302]。

**3. 策略風險與競爭挑戰**
Meta 的長期投資面臨顯著的不確定性。在 RL 策略上，元宇宙可能不會如預期發展，市場對相關產品的接受度仍未知 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。Meta 在消費性硬體產品及虛擬與擴增實境技術方面的經驗相對有限，這可能使其他公司能更有效地與其競爭 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。此外，部分消費性硬體產品依賴第三方行動平台運作，而這些平台不一定會提供與其自身競爭產品相同水準的互操作性 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。RL 的努力也可能分散其他業務領域的資源與管理層注意力 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]。

在廣告與用戶競爭方面，競爭產品與服務已減少了部分用戶對 Meta 產品的參與度，特別是在年輕用戶族群中 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #302]。雖然 Reels 的使用量正在成長，但其變現率低於 Feed 和 Stories 產品，且預期在可預見的未來將持續以較低速率變現 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #302]。此外，Meta 也曾因地緣政治條件，在一個或多個地區出現活躍用戶基礎的波動與下降，這些趨勢已對其廣告收入產生不利影響 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #302]。Meta 也在前沿 AI 模型的開發以及消費性硬體與擴增和虛擬實境產品的開發與交付上面臨顯著競爭 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #134]。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 的廣告獲利模式幾乎完全依賴在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 等旗下應用程式展示廣告，按廣告曝光數或使用者採取的行動（如點擊）向行銷人員收費，而 Meta AI 則是一個跨應用程式的 AI 助理，幫助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人連結 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311] [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

## 廣告獲利模式

**收入來源與計費方式：** Meta 的廣告收入來自在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 及第三方行動應用程式上展示廣告產品。行銷人員根據交付的曝光數或使用者採取的行動（如點擊）付費，付款方式可為直接支付或透過廣告代理商及經銷商 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。平均每則廣告價格的計算方式為總廣告收入除以交付的廣告數量 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。

**2026 年第一季廣告表現：** 廣告收入在 2026 年前三個月較 2025 年同期增加 136.3 億美元，增幅 33%，主因為廣告曝光數與平均每則廣告價格均上升 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226]。同期廣告曝光數年增 19%（2025 年同期增幅為 5%），各地區均有所成長，尤其亞太地區，主要受使用者與參與度增加及產品中廣告展示頻率提升所帶動 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226]。平均每則廣告價格年增 12%（2025 年同期增幅為 10%），主因為廣告需求增加——Meta 認為這主要歸功於廣告定向與衡量工具的持續改善——以及有利的匯率影響 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226]。此增幅部分被較低的廣告曝光量（尤其是在變現率較低的地區與產品如 Reels）所抵銷 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226]。線上商業垂直領域是 2026 年第一季廣告收入年增的最大貢獻者 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226]。

**產品變現率差異：** 影片與 Reels 產品的變現率目前低於 Feed 或 Stories 產品 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311]。

**其他收入來源：** FoA 其他收入（包括 WhatsApp 付費訊息與 Meta Verified 訂閱）在 2026 年第一季增加 3.75 億美元，增幅 74% [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226]。Reality Labs 收入同期減少 1000 萬美元（降幅 2%），因 Meta Quest 銷售下降部分被 AI 眼鏡銷售增加所抵銷 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226]。

## 廣告定向與衡量能力的挑戰與改善措施

**外部限制因素：** Meta 依賴來自其無法控制的網站與服務的使用者活動資料訊號，以及其產品內部產生的訊號，來投放相關且有效的廣告 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #216]。然而，Apple 在 2021 年對 iOS 產品與資料使用政策的變更降低了 Meta 及其他 iOS 開發者定向與衡量廣告的能力，對行銷人員願意投入的預算規模產生了負面影響 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #218]。歐盟的 GDPR、ePrivacy 指令、歐洲數位服務法、數位市場法及美國各州隱私法等法規也影響了 Meta 使用資料訊號的能力 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #216]。

**隱私強化技術：** 為減輕上述影響，Meta 正在開發隱私強化技術，以減少處理的個人資訊量，包括更多依賴匿名化或聚合的第三方資料來投放相關廣告與提供衡量能力 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #208]。Meta 也在開發讓行銷人員將資料分享至其系統的工具，以及在應用程式內產生更有價值訊號的廣告產品 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #208]。

**AI 投資：** Meta 在廣告投放、定向與衡量能力方面大量投資 AI 技術（包括生成式 AI），以改善廣告效能 [META_10Q_202509.html, chunk #208] [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #218]。Meta 認為其對廣告定向與衡量的持續改善正在為廣告客戶帶來更好的成果 [META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #218]。

## Meta AI 的角色

**跨平台 AI 助理：** Meta AI 是一個可在 Meta 旗下應用程式、獨立應用程式、AI 眼鏡及網頁上使用的助理，旨在幫助使用者學習、完成任務、創作內容並與他人連結 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128] [META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2]。

**AI 技術的廣泛應用：** Meta 的 AI 投資支援旗下產品與服務的多項功能，包括為應用程式中的內容排序系統、推薦相關內容的探索引擎、廣告客戶觸及消費者的工具、新的生成式 AI 體驗，以及提升產品開發效率與生產力的工具提供動力 [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

**超級智慧願景：** Meta 正在開發下一代 AI 模型並推進其建構超級智慧的願景，Meta 將其定義為超越人類智慧的 AI [META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128]。

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 將自動駕駛技術視為其核心差異化優勢，主因是該公司認為自身在 AI 領域的能力與進展能將其與競爭對手區分開來，並以此為基礎推動從賣車轉向以 AI、軟體與車隊為利潤來源的服務導向商業模式 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

以下從幾個不同面向說明 Tesla 如何將 FSD/Autopilot 技術作為核心差異化策略：

**1. 技術路線：視覺為主與自研晶片**
Tesla 採用以視覺為基礎的技術、系統與軟體來訓練其人工神經網路，並以自家內部設計的客製化推論晶片加速運算 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。每一輛 Tesla 交付的車輛在設計時皆以自動駕駛為目標，Tesla 相信其在 AI 方面的能力與進展能使其與競爭對手產生差異 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**2. 商業模式延伸：Robotaxi 與服務導向獲利**
Tesla 於 2025 年 6 月推出了 Robotaxi 服務，這是一個運用其技術與車輛的自動叫車平台 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。該服務目前使用 Model Y 車輛運營，未來將納入專為自動駕駛設計的 Cybercab [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。Tesla 預期 Robotaxi 服務將擴大客戶基礎，並結合 FSD（Supervised）訂閱等產品，解鎖以 AI、軟體與車隊為基礎的服務導向商業模式的潛力 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。

**3. 競爭定位：自動化解決方案與 AI/機器人領域**
Tesla 明確表示，在尋求成為頂尖自動化解決方案供應商的過程中，其在 AI 與機器人領域也面臨競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。Tesla 預期其 Robotaxi 服務將透過在 FSD（Supervised）與神經網路能力、Supercharger 網路及資訊娛樂系統上的持續進展，在這個發展中的市場與傳統叫車及計程車服務競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。

**4. 技術外溢：從自駕到人形機器人**
Tesla 將自駕技術中習得的 AI 知識應用於機器人領域，例如正在開發中的通用型自主人形機器人 Optimus [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]。這顯示 Tesla 將自動駕駛技術的研發視為更廣泛的「真實世界 AI」能力的基石，而非僅限於汽車應用 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。

**5. 整體戰略願景**
Tesla 在公司概況中將自身定位為「專注於將人工智慧帶入真實世界」的企業，透過 FSD（Supervised）、Robotaxi 以及 AI 機器人（Bots，包括 Optimus）等產品與服務來實現此目標 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。Tesla 相信其工程專業知識、在真實世界 AI 的進展、垂直整合的商業模式以及對使用者體驗的關注，使其與其他公司有所區別 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。

**6. 相關訴訟風險**
值得注意的是，Tesla 的自動駕駛技術也帶來了法律風險。有多起集體訴訟指控 Tesla 的駕駛輔助技術系統存在所謂的缺陷與不實陳述，其中包括要求 Tesla 停止使用「Full Self-Driving Capability」一詞的訴訟 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #227]。此外，2025 年 8 月 4 日，另有一件在美國德州西區聯邦地方法院提起的集體訴訟，指控 Tesla、Elon Musk 及特定現任與前任公司高管透過公開申報文件中關於 Autopilot、FSD（Supervised）及 Robotaxi 有效性的重大不實陳述，違反聯邦證券法 [TSLA_10Q_202603.html, chunk #47]。

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] We have planned electric vehicles to address additional vehicle markets, and will continue leveraging developments in our proprietary Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) features, battery cell and other technologies. For purposes of this filing, use of the term “FSD (Supervised)” includes the equivalent naming convention, “FSD (Capability)” that is used in the European, Middle East and Asia-Pacific regions. In June 2025, we launched our Robotaxi service, an autonomous ride-hailing platform that harnesses our technology and vehicles. We expect this service will open access to an expanded customer base as modes of transportation evolve, and, along with products such as FSD (Supervised) subscriptions, unlock the potential to advance a service-driven business model based on AI, software and fleet-based profits. Our Robotaxi business currently operates with Model Y vehicles but, in time, will include Cybercab, our purpose-built autonomous vehicle. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Products

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Powerwall, which we sell and lease to customers, as well as through channel partners, is designed to store energy at homes or small commercial facilities. Megapack is an energy storage solution for commercial, industrial, utility and energy generation customers, multiple of which may be grouped together to form larger installations of gigawatt hours (“GWh”) or greater capacity. As AI infrastructure drives rapid load growth, Megapack helps to, among other things, increase utilization of existing generation and transmission capacity, resulting in a more efficient use of the electric grid. We also continue to develop software capabilities for remotely controlling and dispatching our energy storage systems across a wide range of markets and applications, including through our real-time energy control and optimization platforms for Megapack batteries (Autobidder) and distributed energy resources like Powerwall (Powerhub). Energy Generation Offerings

We sell energy generation systems directly to customers and also through channel partners. We design and manufacture certain components for our energy generation products, including solar panels and Solar Roof, which combines premium glass roof tiles with energy generation. We also purchase many components for our energy generation systems from various third-party manufacturers to provide for competitive pricing and adequate supply. Technology

Automotive

Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We utilize vision-based technologies, systems and software to train our artificial neural networks, which are accelerated by our own in-house, custom designed inference chips. We are also applying our artificial intelligence learnings from self-driving technology to Bots, such as Optimus, a general purpose, autonomous humanoid robot in development. Currently, we offer in our customer vehicles certain advanced driver assistance systems. Although at present, same as in the past, the driver is responsible for remaining fully engaged in the driving operation, these systems provide safety and convenience functionality that may relieve drivers of many tedious and potentially dangerous aspects of road travel much like the system that airplane pilots use, when conditions permit. As with other vehicle systems, we improve these functions in our customer vehicles through over-the-air software updates. Every Tesla vehicle delivered today is designed for autonomy, and we believe our capabilities and advancements in AI differentiate us from our competitors. Vehicle Control and Infotainment Software

The performance and safety systems of our vehicles and their battery packs utilize sophisticated control software. Control systems in our vehicles optimize performance, customize vehicle behavior, manage charging and control all infotainment functions. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Battery and Powertrain

Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We have designed our proprietary powertrain systems to be adaptable, efficient, reliable and cost-effective while withstanding the rigors of an automotive environment. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. We maintain extensive testing and R&D capabilities for battery cells, packs and systems, and have built an expansive body of knowledge on lithium-ion cell chemistry types and performance characteristics.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. We emphasize performance, attractive styling and the safety of our users and workforce in the design and manufacture of our products and are continuing to develop full self-driving technology for improved safety. We also strive to lower the cost of ownership for our customers through continuous efforts to reduce manufacturing costs and by offering financial and other services tailored to our products. Our mission is building a world of amazing abundance. We believe that this mission, along with our engineering expertise, advancements in real-world AI, vertically integrated business model, and focus on user experience differentiate us from other companies. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. The automotive segment includes the design, development, manufacturing, sales and leasing of high-performance fully electric vehicles as well as sales of automotive regulatory credits. Additionally, the automotive segment also includes services and other, which includes sales of used vehicles, non-warranty maintenance services and collision, paid Supercharging sessions, automotive insurance business revenue, part sales and retail merchandise sales. The energy generation and storage segment includes sales, leasing, and financing of energy generation and storage products, services related to such products and sales of energy generation incentives. Our Products and Services

Automotive

We currently manufacture five different consumer vehicles – the Model 3, Y, S, X and Cybertruck. Model 3 is a four-door mid-size sedan that we designed for manufacturability with a base price for mass-market appeal. Model Y is a compact sport utility vehicle (“SUV”) built on the Model 3 platform with seating for up to seven adults. Model S is a four-door full-size sedan and Model X is a mid-size SUV with seating for up to seven adults. Model S and Model X feature the highest performance characteristics and longest ranges that we offer in a sedan and SUV, respectively. The Cybertruck is a full-size electric pickup truck with a stainless steel exterior that has the utility and strength of a truck while featuring the speed of a sports car. In 2022, we also began early production and deliveries of a commercial electric vehicle, the Tesla Semi.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] 89

Other Litigation Related to Our Products and Services

We are also subject to various lawsuits that seek monetary and other injunctive relief. These lawsuits include proposed class actions and other consumer claims that allege, among other things, purported defects and misrepresentations related to our products and services. For example, on September 14, 2022, a proposed class action was filed against Tesla, Inc. and related entities in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California, alleging various claims about the Company’s driver assistance technology systems under state and federal law. This case was later consolidated with several other proposed class actions, and a Consolidated Amended Complaint was filed on October 28, 2022, which seeks damages and other relief on behalf of all persons who purchased or leased from Tesla between January 1, 2016, to the present. On March 22, 2023, the plaintiffs filed a motion for a preliminary injunction to order Tesla to (1) cease using the term “Full Self-Driving Capability” (FSD Capability), (2) cease the sale and activation of FSD Capability and deactivate FSD Capability on Tesla vehicles, and (3) provide certain notices to consumers about proposed court-findings about the accuracy of the use of the terms Autopilot and FSD Capability. Tesla opposed the motion. On September 30, 2023, the Court denied the request for a preliminary injunction, compelled four of five plaintiffs to arbitration, and dismissed the claims of the fifth plaintiff with leave to amend the complaint. On October 31, 2023, the remaining plaintiff filed an amended complaint, which Tesla moved to dismiss, and on May 15, 2024, the Court granted in part and denied in part Tesla’s motion. On May 6, 2025, the plaintiff filed a motion for class certification, which Tesla opposed, and on August 18, 2025, the Court certified a limited class comprised of California consumers who are not subject to an arbitration agreement. On September 1, 2025, Tesla filed a petition in the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for permission to appeal the class certification order, and on December 18, 2025, the Ninth Circuit granted Tesla’s petition. On January 5, 2026, the district court stayed the case pending resolution of the proceedings before the Ninth Circuit. Tesla’s opening brief in the Ninth Circuit is due on March 12, 2026. On October 2, 2023, a similar proposed class action was filed in San Diego County Superior Court in California. Tesla subsequently removed the San Diego County case to federal court and on January 8, 2024, the federal court granted Tesla’s motion to transfer the case to the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California. Tesla moved to compel arbitration, which the plaintiff did not oppose, and on June 27, 2024, the Court stayed the case pending arbitration. On February 27, 2023, a proposed class action was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California against Tesla, Inc., Elon Musk and certain current and former Company executives. The complaint alleges that the defendants made material misrepresentations and omissions about the Company’s Autopilot and FSD Capability technologies and seeks money damages and other relief on behalf of persons who purchased Tesla stock between February 19, 2019, and February 17, 2023. An amended complaint was filed on September 5, 2023, naming only Tesla, Inc. and Elon Musk as defendants. On November 6, 2023, Tesla moved to dismiss the amended complaint. On September 30, 2024, the Court granted Tesla’s motion to dismiss without prejudice. On November 26, 2024, the court issued a final judgment in Tesla’s favor, and on December 23, 2024, the plaintiffs filed a notice of appeal to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Oral argument occurred on November 20, 2025, and on December 2, 2025, the Ninth Circuit issued a memorandum decision affirming the district court’s dismissal of the amended complaint. On December 29, 2025, the Court’s clerk issued a mandate closing the case.

[TSLA 10-K period 2025] As we seek to become a top provider of autonomous solutions, we also face competition in the fields of AI and robotics. We expect our Robotaxi service to compete in this developing market, along with traditional ride-hailing and taxi services, through continued progress on our FSD (Supervised) and neural network capabilities, Supercharger network and infotainment offerings. Energy Generation and Storage

Energy Storage Systems

The market for energy storage products and services is also highly competitive, and both established and emerging companies have introduced products and services that are similar to our product portfolio or that are alternatives to the elements of our systems or software service offerings. We compete with these companies based on price, energy density, efficiency, optimization and performance. Human Capital Resources

Other Litigation Related to Our Products and Services

We are also subject to various lawsuits that seek monetary and other injunctive relief. This case was later consolidated with several other proposed class actions, and a Consolidated Amended Complaint was filed on October 28, 2022, which seeks damages and other relief on behalf of all persons who purchased or leased from Tesla between January 1, 2016, to the present. On March 22, 2023, the plaintiffs filed a motion for a preliminary injunction to order Tesla to (1) cease using the term “Full Self-Driving Capability” (FSD Capability), (2) cease the sale and activation of FSD Capability and deactivate FSD Capability on Tesla vehicles, and (3) provide certain notices to consumers about proposed court-findings about the accuracy of the use of the terms Autopilot and FSD Capability. Tesla opposed the motion. On September 30, 2023, the Court denied the request for a preliminary injunction, compelled four of five plaintiffs to arbitration, and dismissed the claims of the fifth plaintiff with leave to amend the complaint. On October 31, 2023, the remaining plaintiff filed an amended complaint, which Tesla moved to dismiss, and on May 15, 2024, the Court granted in part and denied in part Tesla’s motion. On May 6, 2025, the plaintiff filed a motion for class certification, which Tesla opposed, and on August 18, 2025, the Court certified a limited class comprised of California consumers who are not subject to an arbitration agreement. On September 1, 2025, Tesla filed a petition in the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for permission to appeal the class certification order, and on December 18, 2025, the Ninth Circuit granted Tesla’s petition. On January 5, 2026, the district court stayed the case pending resolution of the proceedings before the Ninth Circuit. Tesla filed its opening brief in the Ninth Circuit on March 12, 2026, and the plaintiff filed a response brief on April 13, 2026. On August 4, 2025, a proposed class action was filed in the U.S. District Court Western District of Texas against Tesla, Inc., Elon Musk, and certain current and former Company executives. The complaint alleges that the defendants violated federal securities laws through alleged material misrepresentations in public filings regarding the effectiveness of Autopilot, Full-Self Driving (Supervised), and Robotaxi. The complaint seeks monetary damages and other relief on behalf of persons who purchased Tesla stock between April 19, 2023, and June 22, 2025. The plaintiffs filed an amended complaint on February 17, 2026, and Tesla moved to dismiss the amended complaint on April 20, 2026. The Company intends to vigorously defend itself in these matters; however, we cannot predict the outcome or impact.

records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 面臨全球電動車市場高度競爭的態勢，越來越多傳統汽車製造商與新進競爭者已進入或計畫進入電動車及其他替代燃料車輛市場，許多競爭對手擁有比 Tesla 更豐富或更穩固的資源 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

以下從幾個面向說明 Tesla 在電動車市場面臨的競爭態勢：

**1. 競爭對手類型多元且資源雄厚**

Tesla 面對的競爭對手包括傳統內燃機車製造商以及已進入或計畫進入電動車市場的既有與新興汽車製造商 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]。許多主要汽車製造商已在美國、中國和歐洲等主要市場推出電動車，另有部分製造商提供混合動力車及插電式混合動力車 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]。許多競爭對手擁有比 Tesla 更豐富或更穩固的資源，可用於產品設計、開發、製造、分銷、推廣、銷售和支援，且可能因地理位置和經濟環境而實現額外的成本效率 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

**2. 各車型面對不同細分市場的競爭**

Tesla 的各車型在不同細分市場中競爭：Cybertruck 與其他皮卡競爭，Model S 和 Model X 主要與高級轎車和高級 SUV 競爭，Model 3 和 Model Y 則與小型至中型轎車和緊湊型 SUV 競爭，這些都是競爭極為激烈的市場 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]。

**3. 政府與經濟激勵可能不利於 Tesla**

某些政府和經濟激勵措施為在國內組裝或擁有本地供應商的製造商提供優惠，這可能為 Tesla 的競爭對手帶來更大利益，進而對 Tesla 的盈利能力產生負面影響 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

**4. 競爭加劇可能導致的多重負面影響**

競爭加劇可能導致 Tesla 的車輛單位銷量下降、價格下調、收入短缺、客戶流失和市佔率下降，進而損害其業務、財務狀況和經營業績 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

**5. 自動駕駛與 AI 領域的競爭**

Tesla 在成為自動駕駛解決方案頂尖供應商的過程中，也面臨 AI 和機器人領域的競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。Tesla 預期其 Robotaxi 服務將與傳統叫車和計程車服務競爭 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。若自動駕駛解決方案的採用率未如預期發展，Tesla 的業務、前景、財務狀況和經營業績可能受到損害 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #66]。

**6. 電動車市場整體仍佔比較小，受多重外部因素影響**

電動車仍佔整體車輛銷量的很小比例，Tesla 的車輛市場可能受到多種因素負面影響，包括消費者對電動車功能、品質、安全性和成本的看法；對單次充電行駛里程和充電設施的擔憂；來自其他替代燃料車、插電式混合動力車和高燃油效率內燃機車的競爭；石油和能源成本的波動；政府法規和經濟激勵措施；以及對 Tesla 未來生存能力的擔憂 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #62]。

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務是公司兩大報告板塊之一，既為住宅、商業、工業客戶及公用事業提供太陽能與電池儲能產品，也日益成為公司營收與毛利成長的重要驅動力。

**一、業務定位與產品線**

Tesla 將能源生成與儲能作為獨立報告板塊經營，與汽車板塊並列 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #239]。該板塊涵蓋鋰離子電池儲能產品（Powerwall 與 Megapack）、太陽能板及 Solar Roof 等能源生成產品的設計、製造、安裝、銷售與租賃，以及相關服務與能源生成激勵措施的銷售 [TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2; TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #239]。Tesla 也為客戶提供客製化解決方案，整合儲能產品、能源生成系統及 Solar Roof 以滿足特定需求 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]。

**二、營收與獲利表現**

能源生成與儲能板塊的營收從 2023 年的 $6,035 百萬成長至 2024 年的 $10,086 百萬，再進一步成長至 2025 年的 $12,771 百萬 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #239]。同期毛利也從 2023 年的 $1,141 百萬增至 2024 年的 $2,640 百萬，並於 2025 年達到 $3,802 百萬 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #239]。相較之下，汽車板塊營收在同期呈現下滑趨勢，從 2023 年的 $90,738 百萬降至 2025 年的 $82,056 百萬 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #239]。這顯示能源板塊在公司整體營收結構中的重要性持續提升。

**三、與汽車業務的協同效應**

能源板塊與汽車業務在多個層面產生協同。Tesla 在可能的情況下將 Supercharger 充電站與太陽能及儲能系統共址設置，以降低成本並推廣可再生能源 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]。此外，Tesla 的垂直整合商業模式涵蓋汽車與能源兩大領域，公司認為此模式結合工程專長與對使用者體驗的關注，是其與其他公司差異化的關鍵 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。

**四、競爭策略與市場定位**

在儲能系統方面，Tesla 面對高度競爭的市場，以價格、能量密度、效率、最佳化及效能為競爭基礎，並認為其產品規格、強勢品牌及模組化、可擴展的儲能產品賦予其競爭優勢 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。在能源生成方面，Tesla 的主要競爭對手為傳統公用事業公司，以價格和客戶轉換的便利性為競爭基礎；Tesla 認為其太陽能板在美觀性、效能及與 Powerwall 整合安裝的便利性方面具有顯著擴張機會 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]。

**五、行銷與通路策略**

Tesla 透過網站、門市、展示中心及通路合作夥伴網絡行銷太陽能與儲能產品，部分商業客戶則透過 PPA（電力購買協議）交易方式銷售 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]。公司強調簡化、標準化與可及性，以降低客戶採用清潔能源的門檻並減少客戶取得成本 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]。

**六、服務與保固**

針對能源產品客戶，Tesla 提供保固內維修服務，並對儲能產品提供製造商有限保固及部分延長有限保固 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]。若由 Tesla 負責安裝，公司也對安裝工藝提供有限保固；Solar Roof 則另提供缺陷及防風雨保固 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #35]。

**七、AI 與自動化策略中的角色**

Tesla 的整體策略聚焦於將人工智慧引入現實世界，包括 Full Self-Driving（FSD）、Robotaxi 及 Optimus 機器人 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。雖然能源板塊本身並非 AI 策略的核心，但公司計畫利用現有營運（包括能源生成與儲能系統）來實現其 AI 目標，能源板塊作為垂直整合商業模式的一部分，為公司整體 AI 與軟體服務的發展提供支撐 [TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #30]。
